heuristic.applicability: Prefer when TCP/Panda posture differs from home, invocation is mid-skill, or red is already near buffer and switch timing is uncertain, provided state resembles a supervised phase and objects are observed. Refresh TCP anchor each replan.

handoff.entry_conditions: Any supervised red phase: clear/open approach, closed-finger lift/carry, lowering, or release/retreat. Late entry is allowed when red is stable and continuation into blue overlap is intended.
handoff.exit_conditions: Core exit is stable buffered red with open/clear gripper. Segment exit can be blue closed on and lifting while red stays stable. Predicted phase alone is not proof.
handoff.failure_signatures: Predicted phase conflicts with object motion; red remains elevated/follows after opening; closed fingers lack object co-motion; or IK residual/limit contact is significant.
handoff.overlap_role: Complete 210-230 action overlaps remain supervised. Auxiliary phase separates release/retreat from blue approach/closure/lift without replacing diffusion.
handoff.successor_readiness: Use observed red stability and open/clear gripper, not auxiliary class alone. Preserve causal history; late switching through blue lift is represented.

heuristic.limitations: No object-displacement invariance; use red-frame policy for far-shifted red. Phase labels are coarse, not contact/grasp truth, and can be wrong after unseen failures. Large residuals from unusual entries may be out of support. No failed-grasp/drop/collision recovery is demonstrated. Phase has no external memory. Prefer destination prior for precise moved-buffer landing.
heuristic.pipeline_implications: Two causal feature frames contain scaled qpos/qvel, world TCP, red/TCP, blue/TCP and buffer/TCP relations. A registered MLP conditions the standard backbone and shares its embedding with a registered phase head. Labels are world position delta, log(R_command R_anchor^T), gripper. A causal geometric phase label with valid mask adds 0.1 masked cross-entropy while epsilon loss remains active. decode_action reconstructs world target and calls IK. All modules are optimized, EMA'd and saved.
heuristic.rationale: Observed: similar low-TCP states have different intent: 80-100 approaches/closes at red, 240-280 lowers then opens at buffer, and 440-460 approaches/closes at blue. High retreat at 320-340 follows release, unlike initial high approach. Two causal frames, fingers, object motion and distances provide phase cues. Expected benefit: a trainable encoder shared by diffusion and masked four-class phase head encourages separation of red acquisition, red transport, release/retreat and blue-overlap behavior. Chunk-start TCP residuals reduce dependence on one home or preceding endpoint. This is expected robustness, not recovery evidence.
heuristic.statement: Causal phase-and-residual policy: diffuse world position and rotation-vector residuals from chunk-start TCP, with a shared learned causal encoder supervised by a four-class geometric phase target. Prefer for noncanonical TCP/posture entries or uncertain handoff timing.

assignment.subgoal: From an open, clear gripper with red in the initially blue region, approach red from above, close around it, lift and carry it to the free central area, lower it to the table, open, and retreat. The core responsibility is red-to-buffer relocation. The tail is deliberately extended through approach, grasp, and initial lift of blue so a late handoff remains action-supervised.

check.checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Command FK targets are encoded as chunk-start TCP world translation and SO(3) log residuals, then reconstructed by the inverse exponential-map operation before shared IK. The check compares world TCP position, rotation and gripper.

contract.cut_relation: Every assigned action in all 12 [0,stop) segments supervises diffusion and receives a causal current-phase target. The 210-230 action overlap with place_blue remains action-supervised from red lowering/release through blue initial lift.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [delta_x,delta_y,delta_z,rotvec_x,rotvec_y,rotvec_z,gripper]. Translation is a world-axis metre displacement from chunk-start TCP. rotvec is radians for R_target*R_anchor^T and left-multiplies the chunk-start TCP rotation. Anchor is fixed for a sampled chunk. The reconstructed world pose is sent only through panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured qpos; gripper sign is native. Slots are t-1..t+14 and slots 1..8 execute.
contract.parameter_semantics: target_object selects red_pose relational features and the red phase object; successor_object selects blue_pose overlap features and phase object; buffer_pose_world is [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] in world metres/wxyz and supplies the intended center relation and phase reference. Training binds [-0.181,0,0.02,1,0,0,0].
